title: swarm_coordinator_request
description: Bounded data-only optional coordinator metadata. JSON never authenticates a producer or restores live authority.
$comment: Transport canonical JSON is bounded to 65536 UTF-8 bytes, depth 32. Durable projections are bounded to 8MiB and never restore original grants/receipts. Runtime checks enforce exact channel, lease, epoch and scope bindings.

event.title: Ordin Swarm Event v1
event.description: Redacted event data; a hash or evidence label does not authenticate a sender.
event.$comment: Runtime validation also rejects cross-scope/self parent references, requires the review ID among parents, and caps canonical UTF-8 JSON at 65536 bytes. Trusted ingestion separately verifies sender, current identity and receipt authority.
